home.tagline: Leading the way in premium garment manufacturing with unmatched Moroccan craftsmanship
home.aboutDescription: Founded in 2021 in Casablanca Ain Sebaa by Moubarak Amqor, Texam Confection has quickly established itself as a cornerstone in the ready-to-wear industry. Our meteoric growth, serving over 1,500 satisfied clients annually, demonstrates our expertise and ability to meet the demands of major brands.
home.servicesSubtitle: Comprehensive solutions for your garment manufacturing needs
home.service1Description: Expert tailoring and manufacturing of high-end garments with meticulous attention to detail
home.service2Description: Rigorous quality assurance at every step of the manufacturing process
home.service3Description: Efficient production cycles without compromising on quality
home.qualityDescription: At Texam, quality isn't just a promise – it's our foundation. Our state-of-the-art facility combines traditional Moroccan craftsmanship with modern manufacturing excellence.
home.ctaDescription: Join leading brands who trust Texam Atelier for their premium confection needs
